verdict.rationale: Fellow has a public pricing page that lists features such as AI meeting summary, transcription, action items, Ask Fellow, keyword tracking, transcript redaction and uploads. That suggests tier contents are visible without contacting sales. However, the pack shows no free plan, no prices, and no mapping of features to tiers. An Enterprise plan is referenced, but nothing shows whether it is self-serve or sales-gated. Missing for 10: evidence of a free tier, published per-tier prices, a per-tier feature breakdown, confirmation that basic paid plans are self-serve without talking to sales, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can start free and see exactly what each paid tier costs and adds — no "talk to sales" wall for basic use
